description: This file handles access control and message processing for Google Chat integration, including permission checks, group configuration, mention detection, and pairing requests.

methods.name: normalizeUserId
methods.description: Normalizes a user ID by trimming, removing 'users/' prefix, and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: isEmailLike
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles an email address.

methods.name: isSenderAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a sender is allowed based on allowlist entries, supporting ID and email matching.

methods.name: resolveGroupConfig
methods.description: Resolves group configuration, handling deprecated name matching and fallback.

methods.name: extractMentionInfo
methods.description: Extracts mention information from annotations, including whether the bot was mentioned.

methods.name: warnDeprecatedUsersEmailEntries
methods.description: Logs warnings for deprecated email allowlist entries.

methods.name: warnMutableGroupKeysConfigured
methods.description: Logs warnings for mutable group keys that need updating to stable space IDs.

methods.name: applyGoogleChatInboundAccessPolicy
methods.description: Main function to enforce access policies, handle pairing, and determine message acceptance for Google Chat.
